objectives: Explain in two sentences what a Bulgarian notary is and why the state needs one.
Name the main types of work that come into a notary office every day.
Name the roles in an office and what each role may and may not do.
Use the law margin, the law library, the flashcards and the tests of this course.

cards.front: Who is a notary under Bulgarian law?
cards.back: A person to whom **the state assigns** the notarial acts provided for by law, and who is entered in the **register of the Notary Chamber** (Art. 2 ЗННД).

cards.front: May a clerk certify a signature if the notary is busy?
cards.back: **No.** Only the notary, an assistant notary within Art. 40 ЗННД, or an authorised substitute may certify. A certification by an unauthorised person is null (Art. 576 ГПК).

cards.front: Which acts may an assistant notary NOT perform?
cards.back: Deeds that create, transfer, change or end real rights in real estate; acts that recognise ownership or limited real rights in real estate; notarial wills and their revocation; mortgages (Art. 40(1) ЗННД).

cards.front: When must the notary present a deed for entry?
cards.back: On the **day** on which the deed is made (Art. 25(5) ЗННД).

cards.front: Where and when are deeds that need entry issued?
cards.back: Only **in the office** of the notary and only **in working hours** (Art. 573(2) ГПК).

cards.front: What evidential force does a notarial certification have?
cards.back: It is an **official document**: it proves the facts it certifies until somebody proves the contrary (Art. 179 ГПК).

cards.front: What duty of secrecy do employees of the notary have?
In which language is a notarial document made?
cards.back: In **Bulgarian**. A participant who does not know Bulgarian signs through an interpreter whom the notary appoints (Art. 582 ГПК).

cards.front: How long are the notarial books with deeds kept?
cards.back: **100 years**, then they go to the State Archives (Art. 28а(3) ЗННД).

cards.front: What is the euro conversion rate for amounts in leva in legal acts?
cards.back: **1.95583 leva = 1 euro**, with rounding to the cent (Art. 11–13 ЗВЕРБ).

quiz.question: Who assigns notarial functions to the notary?
quiz.explanation: The notary is a person to whom the state assigns notarial acts. The Chamber keeps the register.

quiz.question: A client asks the secretary to certify a signature because the notary is at lunch. What is right?
options: The secretary refuses: only the notary, an assistant notary or a substitute may certify
The secretary certifies and the notary countersigns later
The secretary may certify signatures but not deeds
The secretary may certify if the client is known to the office
quiz.explanation: Employees never perform notarial acts. A certification by a person without the right is null.

quiz.question: Which act may an assistant notary perform on the instructions of the notary?
options: Certification of the signature on a power of attorney
A notarial deed for the sale of an apartment
quiz.explanation: Art. 40(1) excludes real-estate deeds, acts recognising ownership, notarial wills and mortgages. Certifications of signatures are allowed.

quiz.question: A notarial deed for a sale of land is signed on Tuesday. When must the notary present it for entry?
quiz.explanation: The notary presents deeds for entry on the day they are made.

quiz.question: Where can a notary issue a deed that must be entered in the property register?
options: Only in the office, in working hours
At the home of a party who is ill
At the bank of the buyer
quiz.explanation: Deeds subject to entry are issued only in the office in working hours. Other acts may be done outside the office for good reasons.

quiz.question: What is the legal force of a signature certification by a notary?
options: It is an official document and proves the certified facts until the contrary is proved
It is a private document like any other
It is valid only for one year
quiz.explanation: Official documents issued within the competence of the official are proof of the facts they certify.

quiz.question: Who keeps the register in which notaries and assistant notaries are entered?
quiz.explanation: The register is kept at the Notary Chamber.

quiz.question: Since 1 January 2026, how do you read an amount of 30 лв. in the notarial tariff?
Which statement about the 2026 draft law against property fraud is correct?
options: It is a draft for public consultation and is not law
It is in force since 1 January 2026
quiz.explanation: The Ministry of Justice published the draft for consultation in August 2026.

quiz.question: How long does the notary keep the book with the deeds that are subject to entry?
quiz.explanation: Books with deeds and wills and the alphabetical index are kept for 100 years.
